senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דָּלָה)to swing, raise; to suspend, hang. Y. Sot. I, 16ᵈ bot. (ref. to Gen. XXXVIII, 14) תָּלַת עיניה בפתח וכ׳ she raised her eyes to the gate to which all eyes look hopefully; Y. Keth. XIII, beg. 35ᶜ; Gen. R. s. 85 שׁתָּלְתָה … תְּלוּיוֹת בו (not שתלה).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 58b:10">B. Mets. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>לא יִתְלֶה עיניו על וכ׳</he> one must not hang his eyes on a purchase (look as if he wanted to buy), when he has no money; (<cite ref="Pesachim 112b:11">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>אל תעמוד על</he>, v. <cite ref="M02410"><he>מִקָּח</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:2">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>כדי שיתלה עיניו וכ׳</he> in order that he (Joseph) might lift up his eyes and look at them (the Egyptian women).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Snh. VI, 4</cite> <he>והלא … ת׳ נשים וכ׳</he> did not Simon b. Sh. hang women in Ashkelon? <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כיצד תולין אותו</he> how is the hanging (of the convict stoned to death) done? <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ותולה … ומתירין וכ׳</he> and one person hangs him as the butchers suspend animals, and he is taken down at once. Ib. 46ᵇ <he>צוה … ותְלָאוּהוּ</he> the king gave the order, and they hanged him.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 20:1">Sabb. XX, 1</cite> <he>תולין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02933"><he>מְשַׁמֶּרֶת</he></cite>.
Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ top תְּלָיָין וכ׳ (strike out תלו), v. גַּרְדּוֹם; a. fr.—Trnsf. to hang on; to attach, assign.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 109b">B. Bath. 109ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01419"><he>קַלְקָלָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:3">Nidd. IX, 3</cite> <he>הרי זו תוֹלָה בה</he> she may trace (the bloodstain) to her (the woman to whom she had lent the garment).
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>ותוֹלוֹת זו זו</he> each of them may assign the cause of the stain to the other.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 8:2">Ib. VIII, 2</cite> <he>ותולה … לִתְלוֹת</he> and she may assign the cause to anything that she may possibly assign it to; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="V00578"><he>תָּלוּי</he></cite>; f. <he>תְּלוּיָה</he>; pl. <he>תְּלוּיִים</he>, <cite ref="V00729"><he>תְּלוּיִין</he></cite>; <he>תְּלוּיוֹת</he>. Sabb. l. c. <he>נותנין לת׳ בשבת</he> you may pour wine into the suspended strainer on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:1:5">Y. Gitt. VII, 48ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בחזקת שהנשמה ת׳ בו</he> under the presumption that the soul was yet attached to him (that he was still of a sane mind).
<cite ref="Chullin 135a:18">Ḥull. 135ᵃ</cite> <he>דבר שהנשמה ת׳ בו</he> a limb on which life depends, a vital organ.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 97b:14">Snh. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>ואין הדבר ת׳ וכ׳</he>, and the thing (redemption) depends &c., v. <cite ref="S01779"><he>קֵץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:7">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>שכל העינים ת׳ בו</he> to which all eyes are lifted up, v. supra.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 39b:7">Kidd. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>תחיית המתים ת׳ בה</he>, v. <cite ref="V00359"><he>תְּחִיָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:9">Ib. I, 9</cite> <he>מצוה שהיא ת׳ בארץ</he> a command which is made dependent on the land (of Israel, to which the Biblical text attaches living in Palestine as a condition).
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:8">Ḥag. I, 8</cite> <he>כהררים הת׳ בשערה</he>, v. <cite ref="E00808"><he>הַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00548"><he>עיי״ן</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to hold in suspense, leave undecided, leave in doubt; to be suspended.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:8">Yoma VIII, 8</cite> <he>ועל החמורות הוא תולה עד וכ׳</he> as to heavy sins, he (who repents) is in suspense (will neither be punished nor acquitted), until the Day of Atonement comes and brings forgiveness. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 20 <he>וכשאני תולה על חטאיו וכ׳</he> when I suspend judgment for a man’s sins, I am called El Shadday.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>אם … היתה תוֹלָה לה</he> if she (the Soṭah) has any merit, it will create suspension of punishment for her; <he>יש זכות תולה שנה אחת וכ׳</he> some merits create a suspension of one year, some of two &c. Ib. 5 <he>אין זכות תולה במים וכ׳</he> in the case of testing waters merit causes no suspension.

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:4">Pes. I, 4</cite> <he>אוכלין … ותוֹלִין כל חמש וכ׳</he> you may eat (leavened bread on the eve of Passover) to four hours of the day, and hold it in suspense during the fifth hour, and burn it &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>תולין לא אוכלין וכ׳</he> they held it in suspense: they did not eat it, nor did they burn it; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 1:7">Ib. 7</cite> they differ <he>על הת׳ ועל הטמאה</he> concerning T’rumah in suspense (under suspicion of uncleanness) and such as is surely unclean.
<cite ref="Niddah 60a:40">Nidd. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>טהור ות׳</he> a clean person and one under doubt of uncleanness; a. fr.—<he>אשם ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A03323"><he>אָשָׁם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Snh. VI, 4</cite> <he>האיש נִתְלֶה ואין האשה נִתְלֵית</he> a man (stoned to death) is hanged, but a woman must not be hanged.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כל … נִתְלִין</he> all persons that are put to death by stoning are afterwards hanged. Y. Taan. IV, 67ᵈ <he>להִיתָּלוֹת בה</he>, v. <cite ref="J00716"><he>יָתֵד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:13">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>הִיתָּלֶה</he>, v. <cite ref="A01306"><he>אִילָּן</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4">Lam. R. to IV, 22</cite> <he>למה … להתלות בית וכ׳</he> why were divine visitations created to be movable (to be taken from one and put on another)? (As we say,) they have a house to go to (with ref. to Lam. l. c. a.
<cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:15">Deut. VII, 15</cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> <he>מַתְלֵא בעקיבו</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 961:29">Yalk. Prov. 961</cite> <he>מַתְלֶה</he>, v. <cite ref="P01145"><he>עָקֵב</he></cite>.
